scoring_justification: Recompute of per-ion dipole and net polarization error from agent's submitted dipole_results.json against the paper's published Table 1 values, which are the definitive reference.

required.paraelectric: array of objects with string ion_label, float total_dipole_D, float pa_D, float pb_D, float pc_D
required.ferroelectric: array of objects with string ion_label, float total_dipole_D, float pa_D, float pb_D, float pc_D

outputs.description: JSON containing per-ion dipole moments and total spontaneous polarization, recomputed by checker from the same crystal structure data.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference per-ion dipole moments and total spontaneous polarization from the paper's Table 1.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 1 of Bajpai, phys. stat. sol. (b) 153, 101 (1989).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Exact values reported in the paper for paraelectric (+80°C) and ferroelectric (-140°C) phases, and net polarization 0.21 μC/cm².
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the authoritative experimental results the reproduction must match; they are taken directly from the paper and verified against the reference solve.sh.
